newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Sun Microsystems shrs up.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Sun Microsystems shrs up.

text.p: Shares in Sun Microsystems Inc rebounded slightly after hours, rising 5/8 to 58-1/2, traders said.

The company's stock had fallen 3-1/2 to 57-7/8 during the day after Sun Microsystems slashed prices by up to 38 percent on certain desktop computers and workgroup servers. The company also said its shareholders approved a two-for-one stock split.
The New York Stock Exchange said its session one volume was 30,700 shares compared to 5,600 shares on Tuesday. There was no session two volume compared to 1,205,300 shares on Tuesday.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
